We’re celebrating by calling all supporters to join us for an all-hands-on-deck rally followed by a door-knocking extravaganza.

At 10 AM we’ll rally at the Old Courthouse with Jamaal Bowman and other special guests, and then launch canvasses throughout the day in South City, North County and North City.

This election is going to be won on the ground. With less than 3 weeks to the primary, our goal is to knock 10,000 doors this weekend. We can do it – but we need your help.
